mission_control_cache_contract.promotion_precondition: eq:<n>:EQUIVALENT with n>=25, mode=SHADOW, fresh=true, payload present, no divergence/error, and recent real BG139 webhook requests green

prevention.branch_drift: Generic main drift alone is not a blocker. Rebase or rebuild only for actual merge conflict, changed-path overlap, declared contract overlap or declared dependency conflict; always promote the exact tested candidate identity.
prevention.green_until_done: Failed build/test/deploy is intermediate unless a hard boundary is reached; at most two identical retries per hypothesis.
prevention.security_continuity: Do not stop core scenarios as normal remediation; use safe mode and restore verified full mode.
prevention.rate_limit: On 429, stop discovery/retry pressure, use alternate evidence, then one targeted retry.
prevention.secrets: Never place API keys, PATs or tokens in URLs, querystrings, prompts, logs or scenario mappings.
prevention.production_authority_unavailable: If BG169 or the designated production authority is unavailable, do not bypass it, do not direct-merge, and do not rebuild a green candidate without new conflict evidence. Preserve exact candidate SHA, passed gates, mergeability, rollback target and pending production obligation; resume from the same identity when the authority is healthy again.
